brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu threatened Iran's supreme leader on Wednesday, saying he wants to "overthrow the regime in Iran," Middle East Eye reported. The statement marked an escalation in rhetoric between the two regional adversaries amid ongoing tensions over Iran's nuclear programme and military activities.

Netanyahu did not specify how or when such a change might occur, nor did he elaborate on Israel's capacity to effect regime change independently or in concert with other powers.
dek: Netanyahu threatens regime change in Iran Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday threatened the Iranian supreme leader, saying he wants to "overthrow the regime in Iran".
title: Netanyahu threatens to overthrow Iran's government
